title: Target anatomy
view: Transverse-oblique section of the right hip at the AIIS / iliopubic eminence level under a linear probe, seen from the feet as on ultrasound: lateral (the AIIS) on the image left, medial (the femoral vessels) on the right.
teachingPoint: Needle in-plane from lateral, tip on the bony eminence deep to the psoas tendon; the femoral vessels stay medial.
claims: Right hip in section, lateral on the left, as on ultrasound (house laterality; NYSORA's image mirrored, concept only).
Needle in-plane from the lateral end of the probe, tip on the bony contour of the iliopubic eminence, deep to the psoas tendon (record).
Femoral artery and vein medial (record); femoral nerve on the iliopsoas under the fascia iliaca, lateral to the artery (standard).
Teal: injectate between the psoas tendon / muscle and the bone (record: the articular branches run there).
Labels: Iliopubic eminence, Psoas tendon, AIIS, Femoral artery, Iliopsoas.
